title: The Honor Exercise
headline: How to Honor Someone Who Frustrates You
tagline: Honor isn’t pretending someone is perfect. It is refusing to let their imperfections erase their God-given value.
seo_title: How to Honor Someone Who Frustrates You (Romans 12:10) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Honor isn't pretending someone is perfect. A simple practice for men from Romans 12:10: pray for the person who frustrates you and see more than the frustration.
verse_text: Be devoted to one another in love. Honor one another above yourselves.

scriptures.text: Be devoted to one another in love. Honor one another above yourselves.

items: Choose one person you’ve been frustrated with.
Then write down three things that remind you they are more than the frustration.
- are trying harder than it appears.
- are fighting battles no one knows.
Honor isn’t pretending someone is perfect.
Honor is refusing to let their imperfections erase their God-given value.
Honor begins when we choose to see what God sees.
Love grows where honor is practiced.
